source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-41

procedures.title: Compressor: remove and install
steps: Set the compressor on the mounting bracket and fit all nuts, bolts and lock washers.
Mount the connector assembly on the compressor rear head with new O-rings.
Reconnect the coil lead, then fit and adjust the compressor belt.
Evacuate and charge the system.
Leak test and check for correct operation.

procedures.title: Compressor belt tension: adjust
steps: Set belt tension to the Tune-Up chart in the Engine section.

procedures.title: Compressor failure with metal debris
steps: If a failed compressor contains metal chips or shavings, check the system for foreign material and clean it as under Foreign Material in the System.

procedures.title: Collision procedure: A/C system inspection
steps: Take off the drive belt, cutting it if necessary.
Look over the condenser, receiver-dehydrator, compressor, mounting brackets, conditioning unit, all lines and all controls for damage.
Do not solder, weld or braze the condenser; replace it if the vapor passages in its horizontal tubes, return bends or manifolds are damaged at all.
Replace the receiver-dehydrator if it shows any internal damage, a fractured line or welded joint, or the system has been open to air for an unknown time.
Check the compressor for outside damage.
Check the evaporator; remove, replace or process the whole unit if damaged or exposed to air.
Inspect every line and flexible hose along its full length and replace any that are damaged.
Check all controls and wires and replace damaged parts.
Check that the clutch pulley works freely and is undamaged.
Hook up the Charging Station.
Purge the system; pressure should be no more than 3 to 5 pounds.
Take the compressor off its mount and remove the oil test fitting.

Empty the oil into a clean glass container and look for dirt, water, metal particles or other contamination; if present, replace the compressor and receiver-dehydrator and flush the other components with liquid refrigerant.
If the oil is clean, refill with Frigidaire 525 viscosity oil: a full charge if components were replaced or flushed, otherwise no more than was drained.
Pressurize the compressor to drum or can pressure and leak test its seals before installing it.
Refit the compressor and evacuate the system per the Evacuating Procedure.
Admit R-12 vapor at cylinder room temperature and pressure.
Leak test every fitting and connection, especially the compressor shaft seal if it was not bench tested.
Finish processing and charge the system.
notes: Inspect a collision-damaged A/C car as soon as possible; the longer the system is open, the more air, moisture and dirt get in. Use judgment, each case differs.
